stage: before any fresh calibration outcome inspection
reason: A foreground removal can legitimately change visible target or blocker segmentation despite unchanged physical state. Mask equality is not an eligibility rule.
rule: Require observed control physical-state verification and fixed camera. Preserve all comparisons. Record native added, removed and changed target and blocker mask pixels and primary patch overlaps. Apply locked witness rule unchanged.
distractor_visibility_diagnostic: For every distractor-only control, including ineligible patches, compare whole-image primary RGB mean absolute difference with the maximum of the two base-to-repeat mean absolute differences in the same state. Report both raw values, changed pixel fraction, and count strictly above the repeat maximum. This is a descriptive manipulation diagnostic, not a witness gate.
